name: feature_detect_regs
desc: Edge and motion features of a video stream for object detectors: Sobel edges and a background of cells (lowest / highest luma) with the camera shift from luma profiles, two bits per pixel.

fields.name: AUTO_SHIFT
fields.desc: use the searched camera shift (else SHIFT)

fields.name: RESTART
fields.desc: write 1: background, profiles and shift start again (the next frame fills the background)

fields.name: SPAN
fields.desc: an edge in the last SPAN pixels of the line sets the bit (0 or 1: the pixel only)

fields.name: THRESH
fields.desc: luma beyond the background cell's range by more than this: moving

fields.name: SPAN
fields.desc: fill along the line, as EDGE.SPAN

fields.name: RATE
fields.desc: background moves 1 / 2^RATE of the way to each frame

registers.name: SHIFT
registers.desc: camera shift used without AUTO_SHIFT (cells, taken at the frame start)

registers.name: SHIFT_EST
registers.desc: camera shift found by the last search (cells)

registers.name: EDGE_COUNT
registers.desc: pixels with the edge bit in the last frame

registers.name: MOTION_COUNT
registers.desc: pixels with the motion bit in the last frame

registers.name: SHIFT_USED
registers.desc: camera shift in effect for the current / last frame (cells)

registers.name: SKY_CFG
registers.desc: sky profile: column groups of 2**SHIFT pixels (group g = x >> SHIFT, at most 32 groups); a sky pixel has no edge and luma Y_MIN or more

fields.name: Y_MIN
fields.desc: least luma (R + 2G + B) / 4 of a sky pixel (a dark smooth road or ceiling is not sky)

registers.name: SKY
registers.desc: sky profile of the last frame: lines from the top of column group i down to its first pixel that is not sky (the frame height: all sky); a plane in the sky is the first thing below it
